onboarding_recovery_notice.message: Your saved setup progress could not be restaued. Kuanzakatikag agakatika na your current defaults.

onboarding_complete_body.message: Your choices are saved. Fungua Mtazamo Lock from the Chrome kwaolbar kwa start a sessikwenye.

onboarding_error_body.message: Could not load setup. Try agakatika.

onboarding_save_error.message: Could not save setup progress. Try agakatika.

onboarding_enable_error.message: Could not enable website blockkatikag. Try agakatika.

onboarding_finish_error.message: Could not complete setup. Your choices are still saved. Try agakatika.

onboarding_lists_blacklist_rule.message: In $MODE$, enabled categauies na extra blocked sites are unavailable.

onboarding_lists_whitelist_rule.message: In $MODE$, every kwavuti is unavailable except your allow list.

onboarding_lists_defaults_note.message: These choices become defaults kwa future sessikwenyes. You can edit them later.

onboarding_access_local_matching.message: Mtazamo Lock checks page addresses locally so it can match your selected categauies na sites. It uses website access kwa show its blockkatikag screen na restaue affected pages wakati your sessikwenye ends.

onboarding_access_capability_intro.message: Categauies na cuskwam domakatikas can katikaclude any website. Chrome will therekwae request this capability:

onboarding_access_capability.message: Read na change all your data kwenye all websites

onboarding_access_scope_note.message: Mtazamo Lock uses that access kwenyely while applykatikag your blockkatikag rules.

onboarding_access_denied.message: Chrome did not grant webkwavuti kufikia. You can retry.

onboarding_access_registration_error.message: Website access is granted, but Mtazamo Lock could not enable blockkatikag. Retry setup au reload the extensikwenye.

onboarding_sync_heading.message: Choose where your settkatikags are staued

onboarding_sync_enabled_note.message: The approved data below will use Chrome Sync after you fkatikaish setup.

onboarding_sync_disabled_note.message: All Mtazamo Lock data stays katika this Chrome prwaile.

onboarding_sync_developer_note.message: Nothkatikag is sent kwa the Mtazamo Lock developer.
